snippet.title: Battleplan | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Battleplan is a historical, WW2 real-time strategy game of unparalleled realism and simulation.
Fight across massive battlefields created from real-world geographic data. Create your army by customizing your order of battle and chain of command. Draw directly on the map to create elaborate plans.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743140/Battleplan/
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.gg/rFSRzjEjc6
